description: Search for flight deals between two airports on a given date. Returns cash fares and/or award availability from multiple sources (Duffel, SerpApi, Seats.aero).

destination.description: IATA airport code for arrival (e.g. LAX)

origin.description: IATA airport code for departure (e.g. JFK)

returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format (omit for one-way)

searchType.description: Search for cash fares, award availability, or both (default: both)

name: search_flights
